and.name: Model_Federation
and.description: Root feature representing the Model Federation approach for integrating heterogeneous models and managing their evolution, especially with security concerns. Trace: [Article_11 §III]

and.name: Structural
and.description: Structural aspects of Model Federation covering artifacts, links, graph structure, formalism, domain and technological context. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A]

or.name: Artifacts
or.description: Concrete artifacts stored and managed in the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Model
feature.description: Individual domain‑specific model participating in the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Model_Registry
feature.description: Registry that enumerates the models belonging to a federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Connector
feature.description: Software component that connects a DSML model to the federation, handling attribute read/write. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Multi_Model_Manager
feature.description: Tool assisting modelers to integrate models, invoke connectors, and manage consistency. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Execution_Automation_Engine
feature.description: Component that determines execution order and orchestrates model execution to achieve consistency. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Version_Control_System
feature.description: System (e.g., Subversion) that stores all federation artifacts under version control. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Sandbox
feature.description: Local copy of the repository allowing modelers to work concurrently without interfering with others. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

or.name: Links
or.description: Explicit relationships between model elements across different models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.2]

feature.name: Dependency_Link
feature.description: Reified dependency between two model elements, possibly carrying security rules. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.2]

feature.name: Data_Exchange_Link
feature.description: Link representing attribute flow from the output of one model to the input of another. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.2]

feature.name: Security_Rule_Link
feature.description: Link annotated with a security rule that is evaluated upon changes. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.2]

or.name: Graph_Structure
or.description: Graph representations used to reason about dependencies and execution. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.3]

feature.name: Dependency_Graph
feature.description: Directed graph where vertices are models and edges are dependency links. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.3]

feature.name: Execution_Plan_Graph
feature.description: Ordered graph derived from the dependency graph to drive change propagation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.3]

or.name: Formalism
or.description: Modeling constructs provided by the OpenFlexo infrastructure. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

feature.name: FlexoConcept
feature.description: Core abstraction representing an n‑ary relationship among modelling elements, used to define federated concepts. Trace: [Article_13 §3.1]

feature.name: VirtualModel
feature.description: Container of FlexoConcept instances that can be serialized back to the information space. Trace: [Article_13 §3.1]

feature.name: ModelSlot
feature.description: Adapter exposing a concrete model (e.g., EMF, XML) to the concept space. Trace: [Article_13 §3.2]

feature.name: TechnologyAdapter
feature.description: Component that implements a ModelSlot for a specific technology. Trace: [Article_13 §3.2]

feature.name: UML
feature.description: Unified Modeling Language used for structural specifications. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: SysML
feature.description: Systems Modeling Language used for requirements and safety models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: BPMN
feature.description: Business Process Model and Notation used for workflow specifications. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Ptolemy_II
feature.description: Tool for algorithmic models and simulations. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

feature.name: Excel
feature.description: Spreadsheet used for analytical models such as reliability. Trace: [Article_11 §III.A.1]

or.name: Technological_Context
or.description: Spaces defined by the federation infrastructure. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

feature.name: Information_Space
feature.description: Repository of heterogeneous model files and resources. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

feature.name: Concept_Space
feature.description: Space where federated concepts (FlexoConcepts) are defined and related. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

feature.name: Design_Space
feature.description: Space where designers interact with tools and visualisations. Trace: [Article_13 §3]

and.name: Operational
and.description: Operational mechanisms for querying, synchronising, validating and managing federated models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B]

or.name: Querying
or.description: Operations to retrieve information from the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.1]

feature.name: Dependency_Query
feature.description: Query that returns the set of dependencies for a given model element. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.1]

feature.name: Consistency_Query
feature.description: Query that checks whether the current state satisfies all consistency properties. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.1]

or.name: Synchronisation
or.description: Mechanisms to propagate changes across models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.2]

feature.name: Change_Propagation
feature.description: Process that traverses the execution plan graph to update dependent models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.2]

feature.name: Attribute_Synchronisation
feature.description: Ensures that attribute values written by one model are visible to readers after propagation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.2]

or.name: Validation
or.description: Checks performed to guarantee model and federation correctness. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.3]

feature.name: Consistency_Checks
feature.description: Verification of attribute, constraint and attribute‑model consistency as defined by NAOMI. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.3]

feature.name: Constraint_Evaluation
feature.description: Evaluation of security constraints attached to links after a change. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.3]

or.name: Management
or.description: Support for versioning, rollback and notifications. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.4]

feature.name: Version_Management
feature.description: Use of the version control system to keep historic versions of models and federation artifacts. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.4]

feature.name: Rollback
feature.description: Capability to revert models and attributes to a previous consistent state. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.4]

feature.name: Notification_Management
feature.description: Generation and delivery of notifications when constraints are violated or changes occur. Trace: [Article_11 §III.B.4]

and.name: Intentional
and.description: Intentional goals such as traceability, consistency assurance, transformation management and composition. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C]

or.name: Traceability
or.description: Facilities to track the impact of changes and the origin of security violations. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.1]

feature.name: Change_Traceability
feature.description: Linking a model change to the set of dependent elements and evaluated security rules. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.1]

feature.name: Rule_Traceability
feature.description: Recording which security rule caused a violation during analysis. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.1]

or.name: Consistency_Assurance
or.description: Explicit consistency types defined for the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.2]

feature.name: Attribute_Consistency
feature.description: All attributes have been updated by their owner since the last input change. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.2]

feature.name: Constraint_Consistency
feature.description: No attribute value violates model‑specific constraints. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.2]

feature.name: Attribute_Model_Consistency
feature.description: Model edit timestamps precede timestamps of their output attributes. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.2]

feature.name: NAOMI_Consistency
feature.description: Combination of the three consistency types, guaranteeing a steady state. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.2]

or.name: Transformation_Management
or.description: Handling of security‑oriented transformations within the federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.3]

feature.name: Security_Rule_Evaluation
feature.description: Execution of FML‑defined predicates attached to Security_Rule_Link when a change occurs. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.3]

feature.name: Model_Transformation
feature.description: Use of adapters to transform model representations while preserving security annotations. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.3]

or.name: Composition
or.description: Mechanisms to compose multiple models into a coherent federation. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.4]

feature.name: Model_Composition
feature.description: Definition of a VirtualModel that aggregates several FlexoConcepts representing different DSML models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.4]

feature.name: Federation_Composition
feature.description: Combining several VirtualModels to build hierarchical federations. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.4]

or.name: Conceptual_Elicitation
or.description: Deriving dependencies and security requirements from heterogeneous models. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.5]

feature.name: Dependency_Elicitation
feature.description: Manual or tool‑supported identification of inter‑model dependencies. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.5]

feature.name: Security_Requirement_Elicitation
feature.description: Specification of security rules attached to links based on security analysis. Trace: [Article_11 §III.C.5]
